original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** YouTube video by Peruvian Hotmart seller/affiliate/producer with stated 4-year tenure; third-party AI summary references total billings of $60,000+ and ~$98 in recent 7-day period, but raw verbatim transcript could not be obtained.  
**Verbatim snippet:** "¿Quieres empezar en Hotmart en 2025 y tener éxito sin cometer errores? En este video te enseño cómo iniciar en Hotmart desde cero, paso a paso, hasta que logres tus primeras ventas."  
**Source:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IoyBG0GPEGk  
**source_type:** video_transcript  
**Notes:** YouTube page not directly fetchable. Video description accessed via third-party mirror (videohighlight.com). Description text captured above is verbatim but contains only generic promotional text, not seller experience data. Income figures ($60,000 total, $98/7 days) come from AI-generated transcript summaries on videohighlight.com — these are paraphrased, NOT verbatim transcript. Per rules: What field cannot include figures not supported by verbatim snippet. Finding cannot be properly constructed with available data.
